name: Analytics & Data Dashboard

designIntent.primaryGoal: Help users detect meaningful change and act on reliable information.
designIntent.visualThesis: Data is the primary content; decoration must not compete with it.

visualDirection.density: medium-to-high, controlled by task and user expertise
visualDirection.surfaces: charts and tables share clear alignment; panels only when they define a meaningful group
visualDirection.colorIntent: color encodes series/status consistently; include redundant labels and patterns where needed
visualDirection.typography: tabular numerals, readable axis labels, explicit units and scales
visualDirection.motion: animate only meaningful data changes and preserve access to static values

layout.pattern: filter/period controls + KPI context + primary visualization + supporting table
layout.spacing: compact, grid-aligned and consistent between chart and table
layout.responsive: provide alternative table or summary when charts cannot fit

accessibility.keyboard: filters, data tables and chart summaries must be reachable
accessibility.reducedMotion: provide stable values and avoid motion-only data comparisons

notes: Do not fabricate data. Clearly distinguish zero, missing, stale and unavailable values.
